scope: Production Rust WebUSB and filesystem-worker engines through the Windows USB/WinUSB stack and an isolated QEMU synthetic USB disk

evaluationMedia.license: Windows Enterprise evaluation; isolated testing only; no product key or purchase

artifacts.note: Same standalone production dependency facade and actual packaged filesystem assets as linux.json

passes: automatic WINUSB binding with CM_PROB_NONE, USB MS_COMP_WINUSB compatible ID and registered DeviceInterfaceGUIDs
native Edge USB chooser; exact managed 1209:ca0f ff/06/50 interface; GET_MAX_LUN and capacity
real Rust worker FAT/ext4 create/write/rename/remove; fresh readback and unrelated ext4 file preserved
all six read-only filesystem mutations and raw writes refused; three fresh close/open cycles
SYNCHRONIZE CACHE, successful ordinary eject and awaited close
plain-JBD2 replay after matched external full-backup digest; full raw image unchanged across read-only inspection; clean finish
read-only hot-unplug retires session and closes device; fresh paired handle after re-enumeration reads exact backing sample, syncs and ejects
ordinary removable class08 disk binds USBSTOR, mounts FAT as F:, file write and Flush(true), unmount, independent fsck/readback

oracles.fat: Detached fsck.fat -n exit0 for both managed and ordinary images
oracles.plainJournal: Detached e2fsck -fn exit0; /oracle mode0600 and volume label journal-oracle; sequence44/start0 and RECOVER clear

observations: Windows rejects the final close promise after hot-unplug even though USBDevice.opened is false; the facade surfaces that close failure and retires the session. Ordinary close/eject and a fresh reconnect succeed.

A partitionless FAT LUN must be removable for Windows automount. QEMU's fixed-disk default binds USBSTOR but has no volume. CANOE-BDS ImageDisk already sets the per-LUN removable property; the corrected manual fixture uses removable=on.
notQualified: physical phone browser writes, USB controller passthrough or CANOE-BDS descriptor byte equivalence
automatic firmware disconnect on eject (QEMU requires explicit detach)
complete application GUI deployment or real Windows hardware
